paragraphs: Rabbi Natan ben Avshalom, a Tanna of a baraita.
Mentioned in Berakhot 22a, in a dispute with Rabbi Yose, Rabbi Yonatan ben Yosef, Rabbi Natan ben Avshalom, Rabbi Yochanan the Sandal-maker, and Rabbi Yehudah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied list includes Natan ben Avshalom himself; that repeated name is retained. Yochanan the Sandal-maker is the conventional, contextually clear reading of ר״י הסנדלר.

The checked Berakhot passage names Natan ben Avishalom in a dispute with Yochanan the Sandal-maker. Hyman’s supplied list repeats Natan’s own name among the disputants; that repetition is preserved, without identifying a father or combining separate people.
